description: This PHP source file defines a class `MeetingsViewListbytype` which extends `ViewList`. It manages the display and processing of a customized meetings list view filtered by a specific type ('IBMSmartCloud') within the SuiteCRM application. The class handles checking user login info with external APIs, processing search parameters, and rendering the list view accordingly.

classes.name: MeetingsViewListbytype
classes.description: A view class for listing meetings filtered by 'IBMSmartCloud' type, handling external API integration, search form processing, and list rendering within SuiteCRM.
